correctness.rationale: For I_H=v*Hv the coefficient of e^(imt), m≥0, is ∑ H_{j,j+m}r^(2j+m), so only the ±K pair aliases on a 2K-grid and the common radius-scaled coefficient is H_{0K}. The two normalized real readouts have unit rows (1,0) and (cos(Kδ),−sin(Kδ)). Their determinant and squared singular values give exactly the resonance and the stated κ, including its minimizers. This derives full traces for arbitrary Hermitian H, not just a polynomial lift. A coefficient vector a for P gives the lift H=conj(a)aᵀ in the v*Hv convention. Equal continuous traces on distinct circles imply two rational reflection identities for P/Q; comparing them gives invariance under a nonunit positive dilation. The Laurent expansion at zero is constant, including if a pole at zero had been contemplated. If one polynomial is identically zero, so is the other. Coincident radii give the ambiguity z^K versus r^K; at resonance the Kth powers of both grids are real and 1±iz^K have identical data but are not phase multiples. These checks include K=1 and degree-at-most rather than exact degree.
residual_risks: The condition number applies only after radius normalization of the two real Nyquist readouts, not to full noisy polynomial recovery. If both grids coincide, duplicated labels do not add distinct locations; the failure proof is unaffected.
